verdict.rationale: Phaser's editor exposes an MCP server with ~40 built-in tools that let AI agents/coding assistants manipulate scenes and assets programmatically (e.g., create particle emitters, reorganize layers, rename objects) via natural-language commands, which partially satisfies 'programmatic scene/asset manipulation.' However there's no evidence of a true editor extension/plugin API or scripting SDK that lets developers author their own custom tools beyond the fixed MCP tool set. Missing for 10: documented plugin/extension API for the editor, ability to add custom editor panels or scripts, SDK for third-party tool authors, independent corroboration of MCP tool reliability.
